name: claude-mem
description: Persistent context across sessions for every agent. Captures what your agent does, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
one_liner: Gives your AI coding assistant a memory, so it remembers your project across sessions instead of starting from zero every time.
buyer: Development teams and solo builders who lose hours re-explaining their codebase to the agent at the start of every session.
business_use_cases: A dev team keeps shared project memory so any member's agent already knows the architecture and past decisions.
A consultant juggling ten client repos has each agent instantly recall that client's context on reconnect.
A long-running project retains 'why we did it this way' so new AI sessions don't repeat old mistakes.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted team-memory service with shared, searchable project context and access controls.
An enterprise add-on that keeps agent memory on the company's own servers for compliance.

steal_this: Build a simple 'team brain' web view on top of it: a searchable timeline of what every agent learned about a project, sold to engineering managers.
